parsed.rationale: All three initializers — `HSBColor.init(hue:saturation:brightness:)` in package `ColorPalette`, and `AccentColor.init(hue:saturation:brightness:)` plus `HSBOffset.init(hue:saturation:brightness:)` in package `Wallpaper` — are flagged as exact function duplicates with identical signatures. None of the participating records carry any restraint markers (is_test, is_mock, is_sample_app, is_codegen are all false). The duplication reflects a shared HSB construction contract across three distinct domain types; the idiomatic Swift remedy is to introduce a protocol `HSBInitializable` with a required `init(hue:saturation:brightness:)` and provide a default implementation in a protocol extension within the `ColorPalette` package (which already owns the canonical `HSBColor` type), allowing `AccentColor` and `HSBOffset` in `Wallpaper` to conform and delete their bespoke implementations. This avoids coupling `Wallpaper` to `ColorPalette` at the type level while still eliminating the duplicated initializer body.
